reviews.title: good for major cities. useless for smaller towns
reviews.text: I live 45mins north of West Palm Beach , i don’t want to get married near the city but this app ONLY gives you venues and vendors in bigger areas . it won’t even show me venues in my area (i know there’s plenty)
